result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but there are a few visual issues: horizontally clipped content on the right edge (category chips and restaurant cards) without clear scroll affordance, and a confusing '-0%' discount badge that reads as a content/logic error.

issues.description: The discount badge on the second 'Popular right now' card shows '-0%', which is a meaningless value (zero percent off) and looks like a data or formatting bug.
issues.suggestion: Hide the badge when the discount is 0%, or display the correct percentage (e.g. '-10%'). Never render a '-0%' promotion.

issues.description: The category filter row ('Healthy' chip) and the 'Fastest near you' carousel ('Trattoria Piccol...') are cut off at the right screen edge with no visible scroll indicator or fade-out, so it is not obvious that more content is available horizontally.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge gradient fade or partial peek of the next item, plus scroll-snap behavior, to signal horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated mid-word with no ellipsis styling consistency and limited visible context in the card.
issues.suggestion: Use a proper text-ellipsis with a max-width constraint and ensure the full name is accessible via tooltip or on tap.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icons on the 'Popular right now' cards sit on varied image backgrounds; the dark circular background on the ramen card is fine, but contrast of the white outline icon may be insufficient on lighter images.
issues.suggestion: Ensure a consistent semi-transparent dark backing behind the favorite icon on all cards to guarantee icon contrast against any image.
